summary.name: Unforgettable Car AI
summary.one_liner: A paid web tool that turns one waist-up selfie (optionally plus a car photo) into a locked ~10-second 9:16 "24 card" car reveal MP4 in the style of a viral trend.
use_cases: Make a viral-style car reveal reel from a selfie
Show a dream car or private jet behind yourself in a short video
Create a vertical 9:16 clip for TikTok, Reels or Shorts
Generate a trend video without writing a prompt or editing timeline
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes one waist-up selfie, with an optional whole-car photo or a preset car such as a red sports car, and generates a locked template of about 10 seconds (sample clips shown as about 15 seconds) in 9:16 or 16:9 at 720p with no watermark. The video follows a fixed sequence: walk-up, flicking two and four cards at the camera, and a car appearing behind the subject. Users upload and generate in the browser and pay per render through Stripe; failed renders refund credits automatically. Renders are silent, so the trend sound must be added separately when posting.
notable: Fixed 24-card flick and car reveal template with no prompt writing or CapCut timeline needed
Credit packs from $8.88 one-time, with no subscription
Requires adults 18+ with photo rights; independent fan tool not affiliated with the original creators or CapCut
caveats: Not free: packs start at $8.88 for one 720p render (500 credits), with 1500 and 5000 credit packs also offered
Browser-only with no native app; payment via Stripe, and render download links expire in about 24 hours
Output is silent; the commercial Unforgettable track is not included and commercial use needs a music licence
